name: applicant email
script:
if doc.custom_recruitment == "Placement" and doc.custom_student_: try: # Fetch student details from the Student DocType student_doc = frappe.get_doc("Student", doc.custom_student_) student_email = student_doc.student_email_id student_name = student_doc.first_name or "Candidate" # Get session user's full name from the User DocType user_doc = frappe.get_doc("User", frappe.session.user) session_user_fullname = user_doc.full_name or "Placement Head" # Fetch company details from the Customer DocType company_doc = frappe.get_doc("Customer", doc.custom_hiring_company) company_website = company_doc.website.strip() if company_doc.website else "#" if student_email: # Email Subject & Message subject = f"Job Application Update: {doc.job_title} at {doc.custom_hiring_company}" message = f"""

Dear {student_name},

We are pleased to inform you that we have forwarded your resume to {doc.custom_hiring_company} HR for the vacancies available as {doc.designation}.

You will receive an interview call soon from the HR department.

We kindly remind you that upon joining the company, it is expected that you fulfill the designated duration of employment as agreed upon.

In preparation for potential interviews, we encourage you to thoroughly prepare and showcase your qualifications and experiences effectively.

Please note that upon completion of the training period, the firm intends to absorb you as a permanent member of their staff. Declining this opportunity may impact your future placement prospects. We encourage you to seize this opportunity, as it presents a valuable chance for growth and development.

If selected, it is your responsibility to join the company within the timeframe specified by HR. Failure to do so will be solely your responsibility, and the Institute will not be held accountable.

Furthermore, please note that any disqualification or termination from the company will be solely your responsibility, and our institution will not be able to provide any assistance or favors in such an event.

Before the interview, please ensure that you review the company information and details available on the company's official website:

{company_website}

Best Of Luck!

Thank you,
{session_user_fullname}, Placement Head
Laurus Institute for Logistics
North Kalamassery, Ernakulam, Kerala

""" # Send Email Immediately (Disable Queue) frappe.sendmail( recipients=[student_email], sender="info@laurus.org.in", # Use your official sender email reply_to=frappe.session.user, # Set reply-to as the logged-in user subject=subject, message=message, now=True # Send immediately ) frappe.msgprint(f"Job application update email sent to {student_email}") except Exception as e: frappe.log_error(f"Error sending email for Job Applicant {doc.name}: {str(e)}", "Job Applicant Email Error")

name: placement email
script:
if doc.placed_company and doc.student_name: try: frappe.log_error(f"🔍 Placement Script Triggered for: {doc.name}", "Placement Debugging") # Fetch Student Document student_doc = frappe.get_doc("Student", doc.student_name) user_doc = frappe.get_doc("User", frappe.session.user) session_user_fullname = user_doc.full_name or "Placement Head" user_email = student_doc.student_email_id student_name = student_doc.first_name or "Student" frappe.log_error(f"✅ Fetched Student: {student_doc.name}, Email: {user_email}", "Placement Debugging") # Ensure Email Exists Before Sending if not user_email: frappe.throw(f"⚠️ No email found for student: {doc.student_name}") # Email Subject & Message subject = f"🎉 Congratulations on Your Placement at {doc.placed_company}!" message = f"""

Dear {student_name},

We are pleased to extend our warmest congratulations to you on your successful placement at {doc.placed_company} as {doc.designation}.

This achievement is a testament to your hard work and dedication. We wish you all the best in your future endeavors.

Best regards,
{session_user_fullname}, Your Placement Team

""" # Send Email frappe.sendmail( recipients=[user_email], sender="info@laurus.org.in", reply_to=frappe.session.user, subject=subject, message=message, now=True ) frappe.msgprint(f"✅ Placement email sent to {student_name} {user_email}") except Exception as e: error_msg = f"❌ Error processing placement for student {doc.student_name}: {str(e)}" frappe.log_error(error_msg, "Placement Debugging") frappe.throw(f"An error occurred: {str(e)}")

name: Interview notification
script:
if doc.custom_recruitment == "Placement" and doc.interview_round == "Walk-in-drive": try: # Fetch student details using the linked "custom_student_name" field student_doc = frappe.get_doc("Student", doc.custom_student_name) student_email = student_doc.student_email_id student_name = student_doc.first_name or "Student" # Fetch the "Job Applicant" document linked in the Interview doctype job_applicant_doc = frappe.get_doc("Job Applicant", doc.job_applicant) custom_hiring_company = job_applicant_doc.custom_hiring_company # Get custom_hiring_company # Fetch the Company (Customer) document linked with the Job Applicant company_doc = frappe.get_doc("Customer", custom_hiring_company) company_website = company_doc.website.strip() if company_doc.website else "" # Get website & remove spaces if exists # Construct website section only if a website exists website_section = f'

You can visit the company\'s website here: {company_website}

' if company_website else "" if student_email: # Format Date and Time formatted_date = frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.scheduled_on, "dd-MM-yyyy") formatted_from_time = frappe.utils.format_time(doc.from_time) formatted_to_time = frappe.utils.format_time(doc.to_time) # Email Subject & Message subject = f"Walk-in Interview Invitation: {doc.designation} at {custom_hiring_company}" message = f"""

Dear {student_name},

{custom_hiring_company} is hosting a walk-in interview for Logistics graduate freshers.

Interview Details:

  • Company: {custom_hiring_company}
  • Interview Date: {formatted_date} from {formatted_from_time} to {formatted_to_time}
  • Location: Details will be shared by the Placement Team

Selection will be based on individual interview performance, and candidates may be considered for various departments within the company. Proficiency in English communication is a mandatory requirement.

We recommend that candidates conduct thorough research on the company prior to attending the interview, in order to be well-prepared and informed.

{website_section}

Best regards,
Career Placement Team

""" # Send Email using the configured email account frappe.sendmail( recipients=[student_email], sender="info@laurus.org.in", # Updated sender email reply_to=frappe.session.user, # Set reply-to as the logged-in user subject=subject, message=message, now=True # Send immediately ) frappe.msgprint(f"Interview notification email sent to {student_email} from info@laurus.org.in, reply-to: {frappe.session.user}") except Exception as e: frappe.log_error(f"Error sending email for Interview {doc.name}: {str(e)}", "Interview Email Error")
